title: Add handoff package: /images folder, .env file, and README.md

requirements.text: Create a dedicated /images folder structure under frontend/public/images with placeholder images for: (1) a hero banner image for the Home page (hero-banner.jpg or inline SVG fallback), (2) service section visuals for each of the 6 services, and (3) an About page visual. All image references in the pages must use relative paths pointing to this /images folder so that replacing files is straightforward.

quotes: Organize all image assets in a dedicated /images folder. Use relevant, high-quality placeholder images (via placeholder services or inline SVG illustrations) for hero banners, service section visuals, and about page visuals.

acceptanceCriteria: A /images (or frontend/public/images) folder exists with placeholder images for the hero banner, each of the 6 service sections, and the About page
All image src attributes in the pages use relative paths pointing to the /images folder
Replacing an image file in /images updates it on the corresponding page without any code changes

requirements.text: Create a .env file at the project root containing placeholder environment variables: CONTACT_EMAIL, RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, and SMTP_PASSWORD. Each variable should have a descriptive placeholder value (e.g., CONTACT_EMAIL=your@email.com) so recipients know what to fill in.

quotes: Create a .env file at the project root with configurable environment variable placeholders for: CONTACT_EMAIL (recipient email for form submissions), RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, and SMTP_* credentials (host, port, username, password).

acceptanceCriteria: .env file exists at the project root
File contains CONTACT_EMAIL, RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD
Each variable has a descriptive placeholder value making its purpose clear

requirements.text: Create a README.md file at the project root that explains: (1) the project structure and page descriptions, (2) each .env variable — its purpose and how to configure it, (3) a note that the HubSpot form on the Contact Us page will eventually replace any direct email/form logic, and (4) instructions for local setup and how to replace placeholder images in the /images folder.

quotes: Add a README.md explaining each variable and how to configure it.
Note that the HubSpot form on Contact Us will eventually replace any direct email/form logic, but the .env is provided for future flexibility and completeness.

acceptanceCriteria: README.md exists at the project root
README documents every .env variable with its purpose and an example value
README includes a project structure overview listing all pages and key folders
README contains a note about the HubSpot form placeholder and future replacement of email logic
README provides basic setup instructions including how to replace placeholder images

constraints: Do not implement a custom HTML contact form — the Contact Us page retains the HubSpot form placeholder
Do not modify immutable frontend paths (hooks, main.tsx, ui components)
All generated/placeholder images must be served from frontend/public/assets/generated or frontend/public/images — not through the backend
nonGoals: Implementing actual email sending or SMTP integration
Creating a real ZIP download mechanism
Changing any existing page content or layout
